days.note: a countdown timer's label under the days, drawn on the email's image

hours.note: a countdown timer's label under the hours

minutes.note: a countdown timer's label under the minutes

seconds.note: a countdown timer's label under the seconds

alt.note: the countdown image's alt text, read by screen readers and shown when images are off; date: Fri 28 Nov; time: 23:59; zone: the time zone's abbreviation, EST

problem.endsAt: Enter when the countdown ends as a date and a time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM).

problem.timeZone.message: “{zone}” isn't a time zone. Pick one from the list.

problem.color: Use a colour written as #RRGGBB, such as #0F172A.

problem.contrast.message: The digits have a contrast of {ratio, number}:1 on the background; they need at least 4.5:1 to be readable. Pick a darker or a lighter colour for the digits or the background.
problem.contrast.note: ratio: the WCAG contrast ratio rounded down to one decimal, 2.1

problem.text: Write what the countdown shows when it ends, in 60 characters or fewer.

problem.textGlyphs.message: The countdown can't draw “{chars}”. Use letters, digits and punctuation of Latin alphabets.
problem.textGlyphs.note: chars: the characters the timer's font doesn't have

check.endedDetail.message: It ended on {at, date} at {at, time}. Readers see {mode, select, text {its message} other {zeros}}; change when it ends in the block's settings, or remove the block.
check.endedDetail.note: at: when it ended, in the countdown's time zone

check.tag.note: the short label on the canvas next to the block

ready.ended: The countdown ends before the send starts

ready.endedDetail.message: It ends {end}; the send starts {start}. Every reader would see {mode, select, text {its message} other {zeros}}. Change when it ends, or remove the block.
ready.endedDetail.note: end, start: a day and a time, Fri 28 Nov, 23:59

ready.soon: The countdown ends within an hour of the send's start

ready.soonDetail.message: It ends {end}; the send starts {start}. Readers who open the email after that see {mode, select, text {its message} other {zeros}}.
ready.soonDetail.note: end, start: a day and a time, Fri 28 Nov, 23:59

ready.soonAck: I understand the countdown ends soon after the send starts.

ready.label.note: the check's name in compact tables

flow.ends.message: This flow keeps sending after {date}; the countdown will then show {mode, select, text {its message} other {zeros}}
flow.ends.note: an automation's publish badge; date: Fri 28 Nov, when the countdown ends
